+"""Camera and proprioception based controller for one reach-wall episode.
+
+Run interactively with ``python -i -u /app/output/gen.py``.  Waypoint calls are
+recorded in commands.jsonl alongside camera views for episode review.
+"""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+robot = Robot()
+spec = robot.spec()
+cams = list(spec["cameras"])
+(OUT / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
+obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True)
+target = np.asarray(obs.meta["task"]["target_pos"], dtype=float)
+layout = obs.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
+
+
+def state(result):
+    p = result.meta["proprio"]
+    vals = dict(zip(p["layout"], p["now"]))
+    tcp = np.array([vals[k] for k in ("tcp_x", "tcp_y", "tcp_z")])
+    mocap = np.array([vals[k] for k in ("mocap_x", "mocap_y", "mocap_z")])
+    print("tcp", tcp.round(4), "mocap", mocap.round(4),
+          "target", target.round(4), "distance", round(float(np.linalg.norm(tcp-target)), 4),
+          "time_left", result.meta.get("time_left_s"), flush=True)
+    return tcp, mocap
+
+
+def save_views(result, name):
+    for cam, im in result.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(np.ascontiguousarray(im)).save(OUT / f"{name}_{cam}.png")
+    for cam, depth in result.depth.items():
+        np.save(OUT / f"{name}_{cam}_depth.npy", depth)
+
+
+def move_to(point, *, grip=-1.0, name="move", cameras=None):
+    """Move the mocap target along a straight waypoint segment, then observe."""
+    point = np.asarray(point, dtype=float)
+    _, start = state(obs)
+    diff = point - start
+    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(diff)) / 0.009)))
+    action = np.r_[diff / n / 0.01, grip]
+    actions = np.tile(action, (n, 1))
+    used_cams = cams if cameras is None else cameras
+    print("MOVE", name, "to", point, "steps", n, "action", action, flush=True)
+    with (OUT / "commands.jsonl").open("a") as f:
+        f.write(json.dumps({"name": name, "point": point.tolist(), "grip": grip,
+                            "steps": n, "action": action.tolist()}) + "\n")
+    global obs
+    obs = robot.submit("ee_delta", actions, dt=spec["control_dt"], cameras=used_cams,
+                       video="frames", include_depth=True, note=name)
+    save_views(obs, name)
+    state(obs)
+    return obs
+
+
+save_views(obs, "initial")
+print("SPEC", json.dumps({k: spec[k] for k in ("control_dt", "cameras", "action_types") if k in spec}, indent=2))
+print("CAMERAS", json.dumps(obs.meta["cameras"], indent=2))
+state(obs)
